patch_description: This redesign replaces the fixed ring layout with a modular multistart nonlinear packing optimizer. It generates several staggered/hexagonal layered seeds, jointly optimizes centers and radii using analytic geometric constraints, then recomputes the best feasible radii through a linear program for each candidate. A final certification pass adds a small safety margin, ensuring all circles remain inside the square and non-overlapping while preserving the original public interface.
